methodology.scope: Manual identity-focused review assisted by full-archive added-line search; not exhaustive identity adjudication.
methodology.addition_extraction: Use exported insert/replace hunk b0:b1 spans over body.split(chr(10)), excluding exact lines present in diff_base body. Restored text and encoding-only changes can still appear new and must be reviewed manually.
methodology.confidence: high_conditional means strong internal support conditional on truthful self-reports; no authenticated identity claim. medium candidates are not accepted merges.
methodology.count_warning: These merge groups apply to observed episodes; globally subtracting aliases requires the unsupported assumption that each alias represents exactly one run. They do not yield an exact agent count.
methodology.stable_identifiers: No authenticated run/agent identifier found. Search of UUID-bearing body lines near thread/run wording found only a PowerBI resource key, not an agent ID. Short hexadecimal tokens in handles may be arbitrary/cohort markers and must not authenticate identity. round_id metadata is not a task question round.
